summary: Tested the Triagem lifecycle end to end (start -> save ficha -> conclude -> alter -> delete) on the backend (pytest, 10 tests) and in the UI (Playwright, admin login). Also checked the Prontuário triagem panel and the Agenda iniciar / Prontuário concluir regression flows. All requested features work. Found 1 minor backend edge-case bug and a few UX/code-review points.

minor.issue: Deleting an in-progress (em_andamento) triagem that has a fila_id leaves the fila entry stuck in status 'em_triagem'. It should go back to 'aguardando_triagem'. Reproduced in test_delete_em_andamento_fila_status.

The fallback (by agendamento_id, or by patient + same day) does not filter by status, so the prontuário panel can show another triagem that is still 'em_andamento' or unrelated, e.g. after the linked one is deleted. Consider filtering to status concluida (or missing status).

Alterations are not propagated to the prontuário rascunho created at conclusion (its temperatura/peso/queixa copy stays stale). The panel reads the live triagem, so this is only cosmetic. Product decision.

integration_issues.issue: After you pick a fila entry, the Paciente select can still be changed to a different patient while fila_id stays the same, so the triagem gets linked to the wrong fila. The fila list also shows entries that are already em_triagem or aguardando_consulta. Consider filtering to aguardando_triagem / aguardando_recepcao.

issues: 'Salvar Ficha' closes the dialog. For partial saves, users may expect it to stay open (minor UX).

action_items: In delete_triagem: if the triagem is em_andamento and has a fila_id whose fila status is 'em_triagem', revert the fila to 'aguardando_triagem'
Optional: restrict the triagem_do_prontuario fallback to concluded triagens
Optional: in the Iniciar Triagem dialog, clear fila_id when the patient is changed manually, and filter the fila options by status
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoints accept raw dict bodies with no Pydantic validation (consistent with the rest of server.py)
server.py is 1285 lines and should be split into routers
Dashboard emergencias now also includes em_andamento triagens with prioridade emergencia (probably desired)

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10; the 1 failure is the minor fila edge case)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Tutor Triagem / TEST_Pet Triagem (deleted on teardown; their prontuários/agendamento may remain). Rex now has an extra prontuário rascunho 'UI_TEST apatia' (origem triagem); the UI-created triagem was deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; pytest /app/backend/tests/test_triagem.py. The legacy test edits Mongo directly via MONGO_URL. UI selectors verified: iniciar-triagem-button, triagem-paciente-select, confirmar-iniciar-triagem-button, triagem-ficha, ficha-triagem-status, triagem-*-input, triagem-prioridade-select, salvar/concluir-triagem-button, alterar/excluir-triagem-<id>, triagem-status-<id>, triagem-alteracao-aviso, cancelar/confirmar-excluir-triagem, prontuario-triagem-panel.
